production.note: US model year 2008 only, from Kelley Blue Book (a database): the 2008 Gallardo lists "Superleggera Coupe 2D"; the 2007 Gallardo lists only "Spyder Roadster 2D" and "Coupe 2D" (kbb-gallardo-2007), and the existing LP 560-4 record found the 2009 trims are LP 560-4 only. Lamborghini's release (Geneva, March 2007): "can be ordered through the dealer network starting March 2007". Lambocars gives calendar production years "2007 – 2008". This is the 2007 Superleggera, not the later LP 570-4 Superleggera.

aspiration.note: Naturally aspirated V10 per the release

drivetrain.note: supercars.net: "4WD w/Viscous Traction System" (Viscous Traction permanent four-wheel drive, as on every Gallardo of the period)

transmission.note: supercars.net: "6-Speed Manual w/Optional Robotized E-Gear". LamboCars prints the identical table (lambocars-gallardo-sl), so the manual rests on ONE source. Lamborghini's release says the car "comes with robotized mechanical e-gear as standard" and does not mention a manual. e-gear is a single-clutch automated manual on the six-speed gearbox.

powerHp.note: Quote (Lamborghini release, reproduced in full by LamboCars): "Now 530 hp is reached in 8,000 min-1." The 530 is Lamborghini's metric (CV/PS) figure: 530 x 0.98632 = 523 hp. Top Gear (6 March 2007): "power has been upped fractionally to 522bhp" (topgear-gallardo-sl). No separate US SAE rating was found, so powerStandard is DIN PS. KBB lists "520 - 530 hp" for the 2008 Gallardo range.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: rests on ONE source. Quote (supercars.net, "Editorial Team" spec table): "1470 kg / 3241 lbs" (curb). LamboCars' table (lambocars-gallardo-sl) is word-for-word identical, so it is the same source, not an independent second one. NO US-market weight has been found, and the market the 1,470 kg figure describes is unknown. Lamborghini gives only a European empty (dry) figure, 100 kg below the standard Gallardo's "weight when empty (1,430 kg)", i.e. 1,330 kg, and says the US car saves less: "a 100 kg reduction in weight (USA 70 kg)" (jalopnik-gallardo-sl, the release reproduced); no US figure is printed, so the 1,330 kg dry figure is not a US weight. Top Gear calls 1,330 kg "kerb weight" (topgear-gallardo-sl), contrary to Lamborghini's own wording.
